title: Clothing Boutique Design 140 m², Kyiv | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 140 m² clothing boutique in Kyiv: design project, 3D visualization, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Interior design of a women’s clothing boutique in Kyiv, Ukraine

blocks.text: Interior design of a women’s clothing boutique in Kyiv, Ukraine

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) completed an interior design and turnkey renovation project for a women’s clothing boutique in Kyiv, Ukraine.

The main goal of the project was to create a stylish, functional, and visually striking commercial interior that showcases the clothing collections, supports the boutique’s brand identity, and creates a comfortable atmosphere for shoppers.
The project includes photorealistic 3D visualizations of the boutique interior, allowing the layout, furniture, lighting, materials, and overall atmosphere of the space to be evaluated in advance.

Women’s clothing boutique interior design The interior concept was developed specifically for a women’s clothing store, where the aesthetics of the space must go hand in hand with convenience and functionality.
Special attention was given to the organization of display areas for the collections, customer flow, lighting, furniture, and visual accents.
The layout makes efficient use of the commercial floor area while maintaining a sense of open, comfortable space.
Retail space layout A well-planned layout helps shoppers move comfortably through the boutique, while the collections on display remain clearly visible and easy to access.
The project took into account the placement of the main functional areas:
— clothing display areas;
— retail racks, shelving, and storage systems;
— fitting rooms;
— customer flow routes;
— checkout and service area;
— decorative and branded elements;
— lighting and interior accents.
The result is a functional commercial interior designed for both shopper comfort and an impressive presentation of the clothing.
Custom furniture for the boutique Furniture and retail fixtures are an important part of the store’s overall interior concept.
Custom furniture solutions make efficient use of the available space and support the boutique’s consistent visual style.
Shelving, display cases, storage systems, racks, counters, and other furniture elements are integrated into the interior and adapted to the specific features of the particular retail space.

Clothing boutique lighting Lighting plays an important role in a clothing store interior. It affects the atmosphere of the space, the perception of colors and materials, and the presentation of merchandise.

The lighting concept was designed to highlight the clothing collections, architectural and interior details, furniture, and the boutique’s main functional areas, while creating a comfortable atmosphere for visitors.
3D visualization of the boutique interior Photorealistic 3D interior visualizations were created for the project, showing what the boutique would look like before work began.
The visualizations make it possible to evaluate the layout, furniture, finishing materials, lighting, color combinations, retail areas, and the overall atmosphere of the future space.
This approach helps finalize the design concept and gain a clear visual picture of the interior before the project is implemented.

Turnkey design and renovation of a commercial space The project was carried out as a comprehensive interior design and turnkey renovation solution for the boutique — from concept development to its implementation.
A comprehensive approach brings together interior design, technical solutions, furniture, materials, lighting, and renovation work within a single concept.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designs interiors for boutiques, stores, offices, beauty salons, and other commercial spaces.

Need turnkey design and renovation for a boutique, store, office, or beauty salon? DUMSKAYA DESIGN creates stylish and functional commercial interiors — from concept and 3D visualization to full implementation.
